title: MultiWave: A computational laboratory for adaptive numerical methods approximating hyperbolic balance laws
summary: The MultiWave C++-framework for adaptive numerical methods approximating hyperbolic balance laws is presented. MultiWave has been designed as a computational laboratory where new mathematical concepts can be quickly implemented and tested. Starting from the mathematical background and proceeding to the low-level implementation details, the realisation of a discontinuous Galerkin method with multiresolution-based grid adaptation is demonstrated.
